blocks.text: COTABATO CITY — Bangsamoro Chief Minister Abdulraof Macacua swore in new deputy ministers for four ministries of the Bangsamoro Government on Monday. The new deputy ministers are Atty. Abubakar Katambak, Ministry of Basic, Higher and Technical Education; Nur-Ainee Tan Lim, Ministry of Social Services and Development; Edchamcy Abelardo, Ministry of Indigenous Peoples’ Affairs; and Engr. Dimaporo Diocolano, Ministry of Labor and Employment. He also installed Member of Parliament Dr. Camid Gandamra Jr. as program manager of the Marawi Rehabilitation Program (MRP).
